newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Many overboard in islands protest collision -Taiwan.
newsitem.headline: Many overboard in islands protest collision -Taiwan.

text.p: A boat ferrying reporters to an East China Sea protest over Tokyo's claims to a disputed island chain collided with a Japanese patrol boat on Monday, hurling many journalists overboard, Taiwan's defence ministry said.
"We received information that at least 10 reporters fell overboard due to the impact," a defence ministry spokesman said by telephone. "They have been picked up by the vessel Hsinhai."
There was no independent confirmation of the report.

The spokesman, quoting reports from a special military task force monitoring the protest, said everyone had been rescued and that emergency rescue vessels were never summoned. Details of the collision were not immediately available.

There was no word on the fate of the affected boat. It was one of a half-dozen fishing boats hired by journalists covering a protest flotilla that tried to carry Taiwan and Hong Kong activists a chain of disputed islands claimed by Japan as the Senkakus and by Taiwan and China as the Diaoyus.
